description: Moving Traffic - Penalty Charge Notices issued per Bus Gate/Bus Lane issued monthly is a dataset listed in Leicester Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. This data highlights total number of Penalty Charge Notices issued per Bus Gate/Bus Lane each month. Please note - there is no income value given to each individual Bus Gate/Bus Lane because all Penalty Charge Notices are paid against a specific reference number. Coverage: Leicester. The portal files it under Parking and Mobility. Its keywords are PCN, Penalty Charge Notice, Bus Gate, Bus Lane. The portal shows 159 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-07-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-leicester-gov-uk-portal.
